title: Provider Adapter & Capability-Negotiation Framework

future_start_resolution: freshly verify then-current AIOC and application heads and re-read completed AAI-01 provider/API/license evidence plus AAI-02 canonical provider/source/asset/cue/soundscape contracts
define a provider-neutral adapter interface whose advertised operations are capability evidence rather than inferred support
define explicit capability negotiation outcomes that preserve AAI-01 supported, unsupported, unknown, not-publicly-documented and provider-contact-required states fail closed
separate adapter/provider/session/authentication/entitlement capability from AudioSource, ProviderReference and semantic AudioIntent identity

define authentication, entitlement, catalog/search, playback-control, session, mix/volume, one-shot, remote-sync, local-file, streaming, caching and export capability descriptors without implementing unsupported operations
preserve explicit denial/unknown states and prohibit scraping, reverse engineering, content-copy workarounds or provider-specific hacks
define deterministic adapter selection/negotiation receipts and explicit unavailable/manual/external-reference outcomes without performing AAI-04 playback or AAI-05 semantic resolution
preserve existing World/Event/Scene/Combat/Action/Visibility/D29 owners and AAI-02 non-mutating owner references
determine whether AAI-03 needs any durable runtime persistence and reserve migration 0022 only if a separately demonstrated schema delta actually requires it
resolve exact AAI-03 deliverables, focused tests/verifier, compatibility regressions and exact-head self-hosted acceptance gate before creating an implementation branch
selection_contract.authority_rule: Selection authorizes planning resolution only. It does not authorize an implementation branch, provider adapter code, authentication, live catalog access, provider calls, playback, acquisition/download/copying, scraping, payment, migration 0022, tester distribution, release or deployment.
selection_contract.provider_rule: Adapters may advertise only operations supported by current governed evidence. Unsupported, unknown and provider-contact-required capabilities remain unavailable until separately verified; no workaround may bypass provider terms, entitlement or rights boundaries.
selection_contract.owner_rule: Provider capability negotiation is presentation/integration support state only and cannot create or replace canonical World, Event, Scene, Combat, Action, Visibility or other gameplay truth.

preserved_boundaries: AAI-01 and AAI-02 are completed_verified with no further implementation authority
AAI-03 is selected_not_started with no implementation branch or implementation authority
AAI-02 provider/source/asset/intent/cue identities and rights/capability evidence remain canonical inputs
audio intent remains separate from provider identity and provider asset/reference identity
no provider/catalog is canonical and unsupported/unknown capability remains explicit and fail closed
commercial provider audio remains controlled/referenced rather than copied absent explicit license
Pocket Bard scraping/reverse engineering restrictions and Tabletop Audio SoundPad site-bound restrictions remain binding evidence
provider adapters may not emulate unsupported operations by scraping, reverse engineering or prohibited content copying
AAI-04 playback/layering/mixing and AAI-05 semantic resolution remain unauthorized
migration 0022 remains unreserved until a separately demonstrated durable schema delta requires it
no provider acquisition/download/authentication/live catalog/payment, tester distribution, release/deployment or real-money activation is authorized by selection
next_action: Selection only. On the next owner Continue, freshly verify then-current AIOC/application heads, re-read AAI-01/AAI-02 completed evidence plus the AAI program/backlog and this selection contract, resolve the exact provider-neutral adapter/capability-negotiation/persistence/validation contract, and only then governed-start AAI-03. Until then do not create an implementation branch or reserve migration 0022.
